title: MFE runtime manifest
description: Served by each shell at /mfe-manifest.json and written per environment by DevOps. Lists the remotes the shell may load and runtime settings. One build runs in every environment.

remotes.description: Remotes by Module Federation name (the remote's `name` in its rspack config).

auth.description: Auth settings for the shell (@org/auth, backend session / BFF pattern, docs/auth-contract.md). Either the BFF endpoints, or { "mock": true } for local development (ignored by production builds). Omit to disable sign-in (private routes then stay closed).

mock.description: Development builds only: use the in-browser mock auth client instead of a BFF.

mockUser.description: With mock: the fake user the dev mock signs in as (default "Dev User (mock)"), e.g. a Corppass-style business user for a business shell. Development builds only.

sessionUrl.description: GET: 200 { user, csrfToken?, expiresAt? } when signed in, 401 when not. Called with credentials: 'include'.

loginUrl.description: Browser navigation target that starts sign-in (Singpass / SSO, backend-owned). Gets ?returnTo=<absolute URL>.

logoutUrl.description: POST with the CSRF header: ends the session. 204, or 200 { redirectUrl? }.

csrfHeaderName.description: Header carrying the session's csrfToken on state-changing requests. Default X-CSRF-Token.

returnToParam.description: Query parameter for the return URL on loginUrl. Default returnTo.

settings.description: Free-form runtime settings (e.g. apiBaseUrl). Passed to every remote as host prop `settings`.

entry.description: URL of the remote's mf-manifest.json (preferred) or remoteEntry.js. Absolute http(s) URL or a root-relative path.

props.description: Extra props passed to the remote's exposed component.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL or root-relative path.
